repository.name: neo4covid19
repository.description: Source code and data repository to build a COVID-19 specific DTI-HHI-HPI network in Neo4j database. This repository is associated with the study disclosed in manuscript:  Zahoranszky-Kohalmi et al., A Workflow of Integrated Resources to Catalyze Network Pharmacology Driven COVID-19 Research.
